Usage: astryx experimental render [options] [file]

[experimental] Render a page to one self-contained HTML file, or turn one back into a page

Options:
  --out <file>    Where to write: an .html file, or with --reverse a page module (default: page.tsx gives page.html beside it; with --reverse, page.html comes back into a new folder page-restored/)
  --reverse       Turn a rendered HTML file back into a page module
  --title <text>  The page's title (default: its first top-level heading, else the file name)
  --overwrite     With --reverse, replace the page module if it already exists (never a protected file; the files it imports always go into a new folder)
  -h, --help      display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the file was written (warnings included)
  1  no file, a wrong extension, a missing file, a page that does not compile, has no default export, imports a package that is not installed, reads a browser API while rendering, throws, or takes over 60 seconds; a file to write outside the current folder; with --reverse, an existing output without --overwrite, a damaged embedded source, or HTML that is not an Astryx page

Examples:
  # Render a page
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental render src/app/page.tsx --out page.html
  # Give it back
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental render --reverse page.html --out page.tsx
  # As JSON
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 --json experimental render page.tsx

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/experimental-render
